fieldValues.title: X1: reference material stops being body text
fieldValues.summary: Drops the four generated dumps from the reading line (the two generated-type-reference dumps, the second reference dump inside Part Extensions, and the Key Invariants reprint) — about 1,700 lines, 24% of the rendered spec. Each type's property table renders under its own concept; the pseudo-IDL duplicate drops; Key Invariants becomes a generated index at the end, marked as an index. Adds a sixth coherence check: unmet-at-reading-position count over the rendered order.
fieldValues.body:
Cross-cutting unit from the read-through (§4, unit X1). Composition and View changes only (spec-document-view, unified-document-view, and the four per-type Views delivered by srs#794); no record content changes.

Per ruling R1 (srs#787 comment, 2026-09-17): each type's property table renders under its own concept, the pseudo-IDL block drops entirely, Key Invariants becomes a generated index at the very end, explicitly marked as an index rather than normative prose. Folds in a sixth coherence check: unmet-at-reading-position count over the rendered order (distinct from srs#795's tree-order check).

Dependencies met and poolable as of 2026-09-21 (srs#793/#831 pin build.399 PR #833; srs#794 PR #835). Correction carried from #794: there is no Theme — the route was ruled out (fieldRow template label suppression forbidden by [T-3]/[T-6b]/[FR-037-19]); built instead on the four package Views (concept-leaf-view, mechanism-leaf-view, example-leaf-view, invariant-leaf-view) carrying labelMode: none. Hazard carried from #794: scripts/lib/extension-index-region.mjs and scripts/lib/invariant-region.mjs locate their splice point by matching literal rendered text — moving Key Invariants to the end collides with invariant-region.mjs's anchor, expect to change it in the same PR.

Dispatched 2026-09-21; in flight now.
